Package index

The project

The object everything else operates on: management units observed over seasons, with a provenance ledger.

agri_project()
Create an agricultural analysis project
units_of() seasons_of() provenance()
Accessors for project components
demo_agri_data()
A demonstration agricultural data set

Covariates

Attaching climate, soil and remote-sensing layers through the source registry, and reducing them to one row per unit and season.

add_layer() add_climate() add_soil() add_satellite()
Attach a covariate layer to a project
build_features()
Build the model design matrix
growing_degree_days()
Growing degree days
crop_parameters()
Indicative crop thermal parameters
phenology_windows()
Derive phenological windows from accumulated thermal time

Checking

The faults that invalidate an analysis, including covariate windows that reach past the harvest they predict.

check_project()
Check a project for the faults that invalidate an analysis

Modelling

Spatial resampling by default, with the optimism of random folds reported alongside.

resample_scheme()
Build a resampling scheme
train_model()
Train and honestly validate a model
predict(<agri_model>)
Predict from a fitted model
stack_weights()
Stack weights from a fitted ensemble

Interpretation

Importance, marginal effects, prediction intervals and model cards.

explain()
Explain a fitted model
uncertainty()
Prediction intervals by split conformal inference
report()
Write a model card

Plots

plot(<agri_project>)
Plot a project's management units
plot(<agri_resample>)
Plot a resampling scheme
plot(<agri_model>)
Plot a fitted model
plot_map()
Map predictions, residuals or uncertainty
plot_effect()
Plot a marginal effect
plot_uncertainty()
Plot prediction intervals and their coverage

Extending

Adding a data provider or a learning algorithm without modifying the package.

register_source()
Register a covariate source
register_learner()
Register a learning algorithm
list_sources() list_learners()
List registered sources and learners
